title: Cap. VIII Arg. 5: Jewish unbelief (Rom. 9:32; 11:19-20) said to be cause of reprobation
pass_a_gloss: From the same Apostle they try to demonstrate that remaining in unbelief is the cause of reprobation; since he casts back the reprobation of the Jews upon the unbelief of the same as cause: Rom. 9:31, 32. Israel, he says, pursuing the law of righteousness, did not arrive at the law of righteousness. Why? Because not of faith. Where the solution of the question concerning the cause of the reprobation of the Jews is indicated. Which itself is confirmed from those words, Rom. 11:19, 20. You will say, The branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in. Well: because of unbelief they were broken off: But you stand by faith, etc. The sum of the argument is this: The Jews were reprobated on account of final perseverance in their unbelief: Therefore this perseverance in unbelief is the cause of Divine reprobation.
pass_b_english: Fifth: from the same Apostle they try to prove remaining in unbelief is the cause of reprobation, since he casts the Jews' reprobation back on their unbelief as cause (Rom. 9:31-32): Israel, pursuing the law of righteousness, did not arrive at it — Why? Because not of faith. Confirmed by Rom. 11:19-20: The branches were broken off that I might be grafted in — Well: because of unbelief they were broken off; but you stand by faith. Sum: the Jews were reprobated for final perseverance in unbelief; therefore that perseverance is the cause of divine reprobation.
source_text: Ex eodem Apostolo conantur demonstrare, permansionem in infidelitate esse reprobationis causam; quoniam reprobationem Judaeorum rejicit in infidelitatem eorundem tanquam causam: Rom. ix. 31, 32. Israel, inquit, sectando legem justitiae, in legem justitiae non pervenit. Quare? Quia non ex fide. Ubi indicatur solutio quaestionis de causa reprobationis Judaeorum. Quod ipsum confirmatur ex illis verbis, Rom. xi. 19, 20. Dices, Fracti sunt rami, ut ego inserar. Bene: propter incredulitatem fracti sunt: Tu autem fide stas, etc. Summa argumenti haec est: Judaei reprobati fuerunt propter perseverantiam finalem in infidelitate sua: Ergo perseverantia haec in infidelitate est causa reprobationis Divinae.
